title_zh: 拉萨市对外贸易商会正式成立
title_en: Lhasa Foreign Trade Chamber of Commerce Officially Established
summary_zh: 拉萨市对外贸易商会正式成立，旨在促进当地对外贸易发展。
summary_en: The Lhasa Foreign Trade Chamber of Commerce was officially established to promote local foreign trade development.
